App - revisioned mapping workspace
|
|-- Shared MappingServices (created once; supplied through context)
|   |-- canvasHistory -> isolated archives behind shared service
|   |-- workspaceStorage -> browser record storage and worker
|   `-- diagramGenerator / codeRepo -> generation and repository access
|
|-- MappingPocPage / MappingServicesContext.Provider
|   `-- MappingWorkspacePage
|       |-- Startup: load project representations + storage.load()
|       |   `-- Restore/reconcile drafts -> workspace.setDrafts()
|       |-- CanvasWorkspace
|       |   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|       |   |   |-- DraftMetadata: name, repository, saved baseline, viewport
|       |   |   `-- CanvasSession
|       |   |       |-- CanvasCursorCopy
|       |   |       |-- Read-only observable stores
|       |   |       |   `-- document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry / status
|       |   |       |-- Saved baseline -> isDirty / sceneDirty; save acknowledgement updates it
|       |   |       |-- MappingDocumentController: semantic command boundary
|       |   |       |   |-- ControllerSnapshot: document + canvas + version/checkpoint
|       |   |       |   |-- Context handle -> shared canvasHistory.openContext()
|       |   |       |   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations) / transact()
|       |   |       |   |   |-- -> attached driver settles pending native gesture
|       |   |       |   |   `-- Check version; stage operations on cloned document/canvas
|       |   |       |   |-- updateSnapshot(next, record)
|       |   |       |   |   |-- Reconcile edges/jumps; normalize views/selection; resolve geometry
|       |   |       |   |   |-- If recorded -> canvasHistory.append(context, document, canvas)
|       |   |       |   |   `-- Publish synchronously -> session stores
|       |   |       |   |-- updateCanvas(record=false): transient state, no checkpoint
|       |   |       |   |-- undo(): attached editor, otherwise history.navigate()
|       |   |       |   `-- persistenceChanges(cursor) -> history delta
|       |   |       `-- onCommit(): checkpoint ID changed
|       |   |           `-- -> workspace.onPersist([documentId]) -> persistence adapter
|       |   |-- controllers Map: references to session-owned controllers
|       |   `-- Replace/remove draft: unsubscribe and session.dispose()
|       |-- WorkspacePersistence -> observes workspace and personal view state
|       |-- SourcePaneViewState: personal display/camera state
|       |-- PromptComposerCoordinator / DiagramRevisionReceiver / agent bridge
|       `-- MappingEditorCanvas (mounted per rendered draft; receives session)
|           |-- Tldraw Editor: live shapes, geometry, camera and native undo
|           |-- CanvasRuntime: session-facing interaction helpers
|           `-- MappingEditorRuntime: holds editor/controller references
|               |-- Attach one driver -> controller; subscribe to snapshots
|               |-- publish(): projectMappingShapes -> shapes/selection/checkpoint metadata
|               |-- settle(): native changes -> controller.commitEditorGesture()
|               |-- Native checkpoint navigation -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint()
|               `-- dispose(): settle outstanding gesture; remove listeners and driver
|
`-- /evals: separate consumer of the shared services
